name: live_push_forwarding_seenby
description: All three nodes grouped and already in sync. Triangle: I-H, A-H and I-A (iPhone central to Android). An iPhone edit goes to both peers with seenBy {I,H,A} and nobody forwards; an Android edit likewise. Heartbeats arrive twice (direct and forwarded once). Then the A-H link drops (partial topology I-H + I-A): an Android edit reaches the iPhone {A,I} and the iPhone forwards it to the hub {A,I,H}.
